### `GET /api/v1/projects`

List projects

List the projects the caller holds a role in, each with my_role and repository_count; with all=true, every project (global administrators only, others get 403). can_create tells whether the caller may create a project (global admin, or any human user while the projects.self_create setting is on).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | query | boolean | no | List every project instead of only the caller's own. Global administrators only. Default: `false`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of projects | `application/json`: object |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `can_create` | boolean | no | - |
| `projects` | array of [Project](schemas.md#project) | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/projects`

Create project

Create a project. Global admins always may and can set the owner and the policy fields; any other human user may only while projects.self_create is on, becomes the owner, and gets the default policy (policy fields or owner in the body give 403). Tokens with scopes and deploy tokens cannot create projects.

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [ProjectCreateRequest](schemas.md#projectcreaterequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Project created | `application/json`: [Project](schemas.md#project) |
| `400` | Invalid name, slug or policy field | - |
| `403` | Self-service project creation is off, the caller is not a human user, or a non-admin sent policy fields or an owner | - |
| `404` | Owner user not found | - |
| `409` | Project name or slug already taken | - |

### `GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/activity`

Project activity

Audit events of the project and of the repositories it owns (member, group, token, quota, policy and repository changes, plus events recorded against its repositories), newest first. Keyset paging only: follow `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true; no row is counted. Client addresses are not returned. Any member; a non-member gets 404.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | path | string | yes | - |
| `per_page` | query | integer | no | Default: `25`. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | Opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit for the newest entries. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | One page of activity | `application/json`: [ProjectActivityPage](schemas.md#projectactivitypage) |
| `400` | Malformed cursor | - |
| `404` | Project not found or the caller is not a member | - |

### `GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/activity/export`

Export project activity

Export the project's activity (same scope and visibility as `GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/activity`: `project.token_*` events only for maintainers and above, no client addresses) as JSONL or CSV, for any member. Streams the log as a download without counting rows: entries are read in keyset pages (newest first) and flushed after every page, so memory stays bounded however long the log is. The body is chunked (no `Content-Length`); if the server fails after the response started the connection is aborted rather than ended normally, so a truncated file is detectable. In CSV, cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR are prefixed with `'` to defuse spreadsheet formula injection. Fields: `id`, `timestamp` (RFC 3339, UTC), `action`, `actor`, `actor_type`, `message`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `repository_id`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | path | string | yes | - |
| `format` | query | string | no | `jsonl` (default): one JSON object per line. `csv`: header row plus one record per entry. One of: `jsonl`, `csv`. Default: `jsonl`. |
| `since` | query | string | no | Only entries at or after this instant: RFC 3339 timestamp or `YYYY-MM-DD` (00:00 UTC). |
| `until` | query | string | no | Only entries strictly before this instant (same forms as `since`); must be after `since`. |
| `actor` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the actor name or actor id. |
| `action` | query | string | no | Case-insensitive substring of the action name. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Activity export stream Headers: `Content-Disposition`. | `application/x-ndjson`: string; `text/csv`: string |
| `400` | Unknown `format`, malformed `since`/`until`, or `since` not before `until` | - |
| `403` | Access denied | - |
| `404` | Project not found or the caller is not a member | - |

Set project quota

Global admins only: sets the ceiling over the sum of the project's repositories (0 = unlimited). An upload must fit both its repository's limit and the project's. Enabling a limit initialises the project counters from the repositories' usage. Omitted fields keep their value. Repository limits above the project limit are refused when set.

### `POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/repositories`

Create a repository in a project

Create a repository owned by the project. Requires the maintainer or owner role in the project, or global admin; a non-member gets 404. The body is the one of POST /api/v1/repositories without `project` (the URL names it). For a caller who is not a global admin the project policy applies: format in allowed_formats (when set), repo_type in allowed_repo_types, name starting with repo_name_prefix (400 validation_failed), `public` only when allow_public_repos (403), member_repos readable by the caller (403) and the project below max_repositories (409 project_repository_limit).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `description` | string | no | - |
| `federated` | boolean | no | Enable federation at creation. Only valid for hosted repositories of the formats raw, maven, npm, docker, helm, pypi, cargo, go and nuget (400 otherwise when true). |
| `format` | string | yes | - |
| `immutable_releases` | boolean | no | - |
| `max_stale_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `member_repos` | array of string | no | - |
| `merge_proxy_versions` | boolean | no | Group repositories only, administrators only (403 otherwise). Default false: hosted members win a package name and proxy versions of the same name are hidden. true merges proxy versions into the group. |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `negative_cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | no | - |
| `presign_downloads` | boolean | no | Nullable. |
| `public` | boolean | no | - |
| `repo_type` | string | no | One of: `hosted`, `proxy`, `group`. |
| `sign_packages` | boolean | no | Hosted rpm repositories only (400 otherwise when true). When true, uploaded RPMs are signed with the active GPG key; existing packages are not re-signed. |
| `trash_retention_days` | integer | no | Nullable. |
| `upstream_password` | string | no | - |
| `upstream_url` | string | no | - |
| `upstream_username` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Repository created | `application/json`: [Repository](schemas.md#repository) |
| `400` | Invalid request or a project policy violation (format, type, name prefix) | - |
| `403` | Role below maintainer, public repository not allowed, or a member repository the caller cannot read | - |
| `404` | Project not found or the caller is not a member | - |
| `409` | Name already taken, or the project reached max_repositories (project_repository_limit) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/repositories/{name}/transfer`

Transfer a repository to another project

Move a repository of {project} to the project named in the body. Requires the owner role in both projects (global admin holds both); a caller with no role in one of them gets 404 for it, a lower role 403. For a caller who is not a global admin the target project's policy applies as at creation (format, type, name prefix, public) and its max_repositories (409). Access of both projects' members changes immediately.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |

### `POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/tokens`

Create project token

Mint a deploy token for CI. It belongs to a service account of the project: it can only use the repositories of this project (viewer: read, developer: read and write), never /api/v1/**, and is revoked when its creator leaves the project, is disabled or deleted. Requires a session (API tokens cannot mint). The role may not exceed the caller's own role. expires_at is required when the project limits token lifetime (token_max_ttl_days) and may not exceed it. At most 100 active tokens per project; names are unique among them. The secret is returned once.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [ProjectTokenCreateRequest](schemas.md#projecttokencreaterequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Token created | `application/json`: [ProjectTokenCreateResponse](schemas.md#projecttokencreateresponse) |
| `400` | Invalid name, role or expiry | - |
| `403` | Not a session, or the role exceeds the caller's own role | - |
| `404` | Project not found or the caller is not a member | - |
| `409` | Name already in use, or the project has 100 active tokens | - |

### `GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/usage`

Project usage

Storage usage of a project: the sum of its repositories' counters, the project quota and one line per live repository, largest first. Every repository of a hosted type is metered (quota_enforced); proxy and group repositories hold no uploaded packages. Any member; a non-member gets 404. project.token_created and project.token_revoked events are returned to maintainers and above only.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Usage | `application/json`: [ProjectUsage](schemas.md#projectusage) |
| `404` | Project not found or the caller is not a member | - |
